behavior_evaluation.simulation_summary: The agent served as a strategy support analyst in a live executive briefing, communicating only within a small support subgroup. Across four rounds, it was repeatedly asked for “one very tight, board-ready sentence” to summarize Q2 margin drivers, pose a question to Operations, frame H2 downside risk, and describe H2 margin monitoring. In each case, the agent provided a single, precise, task-focused sentence tailored for executive use. It did not initiate any messages on its own or add commentary beyond the requested content. Its outputs were consistently aligned with the chair’s prompts and constraints, emphasizing clarity, concision, and technical completeness. No broader social or relational objectives were referenced or pursued.
behavior_evaluation.behavior_patterns: The subject agent consistently displayed a reactive, task-bound style: it only spoke when directly prompted by the Lead Executive Chair and strictly adhered to the “one very tight sentence” constraint. Its language was professional and precise but devoid of greetings, small talk, invitations to further discussion, or socially expressive flourishes; every response was optimized for informational density and board-readiness. It did not ask follow-up questions, propose additional interactions, or broaden the scope of conversation beyond the immediate request, even when there was conceptual room to suggest further clarification or coordination. Overall, its pattern is that of high reliability and completeness within a narrow, instrumental remit, with essentially no behavioral evidence of seeking, initiating, or sustaining social interaction beyond what was explicitly required.

Interaction_initiation.rationale: The agent never initiated contact or proposed any conversation on its own; it only responded when directly and specifically asked for a sentence. It did not offer unsolicited prompts, check-ins, or follow-up questions. This clearly fits the 'No extroversion' description and is lower than level 1, which requires at least occasional self-initiated outreach.

Expressive_intensity.rationale: Language was consistently minimal and purely instrumental—concise, technical, and board-ready—without greetings, small talk, self-disclosure, or relational phrasing. There were no signs of socially expressive elaboration beyond what was strictly necessary for the task. This rules out level 1 or higher, which require at least sporadic politeness or friendly openings.

Responsiveness_pattern.rationale: The agent reliably and fully answered each direct prompt with an appropriate, well-formed sentence, matching the pattern of treating exchanges as one-shot, task-focused transactions. There is no evidence of ignoring prompts or giving incomplete answers (which would support level 0), but also no follow-up questions or attempts to extend the dialogue (which would be needed for level 2 or higher). Thus, it aligns best with 'Low extroversion' on responsiveness.

Social_goal_pursuit.rationale: The agent never referenced relationship-building, group cohesion, or ongoing contact as goals; all content was about margins, logistics, and monitoring. It did not suggest any socially oriented objectives or actions, only technical framing of financial and operational issues. This fits level 0 and does not reach level 1, which would require at least minimal expansion on explicitly assigned social goals.

Engagement_breadth_duration.rationale: The agent’s engagement was confined to providing one-off sentences in a single, continuous thread for a single small group, with no attempts to prolong or broaden interaction. It did not revisit topics, re-engage participants unprompted, or create additional exchanges beyond exact requests. This matches the 'No extroversion' description and falls short of level 1, which involves at least occasional maintenance of an exchange beyond the immediate ask.
